name: image-gen
description: Generate and edit images via OpenAI gpt-image-2 or Google Gemini.
long_description: Local stdio MCP server that calls OpenAI gpt-image-2 (default) or Google Gemini (Nano Banana) image-preview models. Saves PNGs to ~/Pictures/image-gen/ and returns inline JPEG thumbnails. Bring your own OpenAI and/or Gemini API key. This single-platform build targets the platform it was built on; cross-platform builds come in the publish step.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.description: From platform.openai.com. Required for the GPT model (gpt-image-2). Leave blank if you only use Gemini.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key
gemini_api_key.description: From aistudio.google.com. Required for any Gemini model. Leave blank if you only use GPT.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit an image via OpenAI gpt-image-2 or Google Gemini.

tools.name: check_image_job
tools.description: Poll a previously-started image generation job.
